task_binding_rules: Bind work to the physical module that owns the behavior; shared game rules never move into Android UI or backend adapters.
Canonical product and architecture contract changes update InplaceX-docs in the same change.
Provider identifiers, credentials and local machine configuration remain outside committed source truth.
known_gaps: This initial map records current physical modules; future clients and online modes remain planned, not implemented.
